title: GOV-0080: enforce scalar/array type conformance in check_schema walker (closes #171)
problem:
🧠 **ARCHI (BARCHI-1)** — Enforce scalar/array type conformance in the `check_schema` walker

## Context

`badf_gate.py check_schema` (the JSON-schema-lite walker) enforces `required`, `enum`,
`pattern`, `additionalProperties: false`, and the object-must-be-a-mapping rule — but it
does **not** refuse a value whose JSON type mismatches a scalar/array `type` declaration
(`array` given an object is silently skipped; `string`/`number`/`integer`/`boolean` are
never type-checked). Discovered under WP-IMP-0 and tracked as #171 (GOV-0071). The typed
planning fields the G06 ladder added (`execution_budget`, `stop_conditions`, `dependencies`,
…) are declared but only value-checked by code controls; a malformed *type* would pass the
schema layer. This closes the gap for **all ~25 gate-validated artifacts at once** (Option 1
from #171), rather than sprinkling per-field code controls.

## Change class / authority / tier

- **change_class: C1** (shared control surface: the core `check_schema` walker).
  Required roles: engineering_owner + independent_reviewer (**BARCHI-2**, shared surface).
- **Version tier: patch** (`0.0.X`) — bug fix to an existing gate control; no new public API.
- DEV Glossary stage: gate hardening (existing G00–G06 enforcement surface).

## Audit-first (done at plan time — the safety gate)

Applied the strict walker to the tree at `d4b8c4a` and ran `badf_gate.py repo`:
**PASS** — zero governed records break. A `$schema`-scan of 89 records found only two
*object* placeholders in `templates/gate-dossier.json`, which is **not** a `check_schema`
target and which the existing walker already governs identically. So tightening the
scalar/array types turns nothing on the ledger RED.

## Acceptance criteria

- `check_schema` refuses a value whose JSON type mismatches a declared `type` of
  `array` / `string` / `integer` / `number` / `boolean`, at any depth.
- `integer` and `number` **reject Python `bool`** (a bool is an int subclass) — and accept
  genuine ints/floats.
- No regression: `badf_gate.py repo` stays PASS on the full committed ledger + locked
  examples (composed-tree suite green on CI).
- Existing controls preserved: the IMP-C3 positive-integer control still rejects `0`/negative
  `max_attempts` (the walker adds the type layer; the value layer stays).
- The change is signed (`lock`) in the same diff.

## Test list

- `test_type_string_field_rejects_non_string`
- `test_type_array_field_rejects_object` (the original silent-skip gap)
- `test_type_integer_field_rejects_bool`
- `test_type_integer_field_rejects_string`
- `test_type_number_field_rejects_bool`
- `test_type_boolean_field_rejects_non_bool`
- `test_conforming_types_still_pass` (no false positives on valid records)
- `test_repo_gate_passes_under_strict_walker` (ledger-wide regression guard)
- (updated) `test_boolean_max_attempts_is_refused` — bool now refused at the schema layer
